text:
anya: Heads-up — running into a golden-anchor reconciliation issue for the new multimodal promptset. Several image+alt pairs are colliding with the existing accessibility dataset and it’s confusing labelers during the relabel pass.

matt: Can you share an example? is it exact duplicates or near-duplicates (same image, different crops, or alt variations)?

anya: Mostly near-duplicates + alt-text variants. Example: same product photo used in different contexts, alt texts differ in specificity and tone. Labelers are unsure which canonical anchor to pick.

liam: This will blow up eval metrics for the new 8-bit quantized model we’re onboarding if the golden set has conflicting anchors. We’ll get noisy regressions. Need deterministic rules.

anya: Agreed. Proposed quick plan: 1) run a fuzzy dedupe pass (phash + CLIP-sim) to group image clusters, 2) for each cluster pick an anchor based on priority: (a) enterprise-sourced images, (b) images with human-verified alt, (c) highest labeler agreement, 3) flag ambiguous clusters for small manual adjudication batch.

eva: Sounds good. Do we have the dedupe query / job config? I can kick off a labeler job once clusters are marked.

liam: I sketched a query for the cluster join — tweak as needed:```sql
-- find candidate clusters by phash and clip sim
with imgs as (
  select id, phash, clip_embed from images where dataset in ('new-multimodal', 'accessibility')
),
pairs as (
  select a.id as a_id, b.id as b_id, hamming_distance(a.phash,b.phash) as phash_dist, cosine_sim(a.clip_embed,b.clip_embed) as clip_sim
  from imgs a
  join imgs b on a.id < b.id
  where hamming_distance(a.phash,b.phash) < 16 or cosine_sim(a.clip_embed,b.clip_embed) > 0.88
)
select * from pairs limit 200;
```

anya: Nice. After cluster formation I'll run a script to pick anchors by priority. I'll also emit a CSV for labelers with guidance and example edgecases.

labelbot: New adjudication job created: job_id=adj-2026-03-20-42, 120 tasks, priority=high.

matt: For anchor selection rules, add one more: prefer alt-texts that include object counts and color descriptors when present (they reduce ambiguity for model evals). Also prefer full sentences over fragments for our golden canonical alt.

liam: Also note: some anchors are language-specific. We should avoid collapsing across languages; keep lang tag in the cluster keys.

anya: Good catch. I’ll add language isolation step (detect lang via fasttext) before clustering.

ops-bot: Reminder: relabel job adj-2026-03-20-42 will start 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC unless cancelled.

eva: For the labeler instructions, can we include a short checklist: 1) confirm correct image, 2) choose canonical alt among cluster, 3) mark 'ambiguous' if multiple valid contexts, 4) note preferred tone (concise/descriptive).

anya: Yup. I’ll draft the checklist and share here in ~30m. After adjudication we’ll freeze the golden anchors for the quant-eval run and run a small smoke test against the quantized model to ensure no spurious regressions.

matt: One more ask — capture a small set of contrastive examples where anchors intentionally differ (context vs marketing copy). We want our eval to catch model preference shifts, not penalize them for acceptable style diffs. Mark those as "contrast" in the golden CSV.

anya: Added to the checklist. I’ll post the CSV + job link once the cluster pass finishes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
